summary: The candidate changes all four production owner-proof client constructions to pass `new SystemClock()`, so `hostedExecutionWait` no longer rejects them and bounded metadata rereads can proceed. The added regression test exercises lagging repair-job metadata for future recovery and owner supersession and asserts the wait, reread, successful authority and zero state writes.

evidence: `src/host/owner-install-future-recovery.ts` now passes `new SystemClock()` to `GitHubApiClient`, allowing `nativeProof` through `readHostedExecution` to wait and reread lagging metadata.

`src/host/owner-install-supersession.ts`, `src/host/owner-install-supersession-normal.ts` and `src/host/owner-successor-acceptance-proof.ts` now construct the same `SystemClock` instead of inline real clocks.
`tests/host/owner-proof-metadata-delay_test.ts` withholds the runtime step on the first jobs read and asserts one 10-second wait, two jobs reads, issued authority and zero state writes.
